newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador to spend $162 mln on geothermal energy.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador to spend $162 mln on geothermal energy.

text.p: El Salvador's state energy company said Monday it plans to spend $162 million to expand two geothermal energy centers.
Most of the funding will be raised by loans from international organizations, including the Inter-American Development Bank, said an official from the Rio Lempa Executive Hydroelectric Commission.
The investment project will begin in March 1996, when 26 wells are perforated on western San Salvador, near the Guatemala border, he said.
With the project, the commission aims to reduce electricity costs, he said. The wells will also replace those other 30-year old wells that currently provide most of the country's energy.
The new wells should generate 448 kilowatts per year, according to the commission.
